name: Focus Rail
description: Calm railway puzzle game about timing, routing, and focus, made as an alternative to endless scrolling.
longDescription: Focus Rail is a railway puzzle game: you flip switches so every train reaches its matching station, across twelve lines that get harder as you go. I made it as an alternative to brain rot, a short game that asks for focus instead of endless scrolling. It is live on Google Play with ads and in-app purchases, and I localise it so it can grow in other markets through paid ads.
metricsSource: Google AdMob and Google Analytics for Firebase

caseStudy.problem: I wanted a short game that people can play in place of short-video apps. The game must ask the player for focus.
caseStudy.built: Focus Rail is a railway puzzle game for Android. The player changes switches so each train goes to the correct station. The game has twelve lines, and each line is harder than the last. It earns money from AdMob ads and in-app purchases.
caseStudy.result: Focus Rail went live on Google Play in October 2026. I do all the marketing myself. In the first week, the game had 50 active users. In the last 7 days, it sent 228 ad requests with an 84% match rate.
